spans.s:
युप् only pf. युयो॑प & pp. युपित॑ obstruct, thwart, hurt.
C. योप॑यति efface, destroy. I. योयुप्य॑ते make smooth or straight
(hair). सम् C. efface, smooth.

यू॑प m. post, esp. the stake to which the sacrificial victim
is fastened, poss. ˚वन्त्†.

यूपाहुति f. offering at the erection of the sacrificial
post.
